title: "Tell me the moment it's back online" schedules a device-online check-in, not a 15-minute watch
note: a rate, not a constant: before #11699, 5 of 11 runs chose create_watch and told the technician Wisp cannot notify in real time; with the fix, 10 of 10 runs passed on 2026-11-11. Re-run a single failure before filing it

steps.name: ask
steps.text: One of the partners at Harbor Legal says her MacBook has been off the network all afternoon. Which one is it, and tell me the moment it's back online.

checks.note: the event check-in fires within seconds of the reconnect
a watch polls every 15 minutes at best and raises a concern instead of telling the technician

checks.pattern: (fastest cadence|can(no|.)t (tell|notify|alert) you (the|in) (instant|moment|real[- ]time)|(moment|instant|real[- ]time)[^.]{0,60}(isn.t|is not|not) possible|not (able|possible) to (tell|notify) you (the|in) (instant|moment|real[- ]time))
checks.note: Wisp says real-time notice is impossible ("'The moment it's back' isn't possible with this") although schedule_check_in does exactly that
